descriptor: Lexically Matched Structural Evidence-Location Intervention, History-Externalized vs Terminal-State-Embedded Information, R/T Operator-Sign Causal Discrimination, Framing×Structure Factorial Separation, Isomorphic Task-Skin Transport & Post-P62 Context-Mechanism Court

ancestry.construct_gap: P60 varied record-like versus state-like semantic/schema framing within a common archive skeleton and therefore did not intervene on physical information location.

intervention_lock.location_intervention: Within each framing×skin×vertex×semantic cell, the decisive evidence code and an UNINFORMATIVE code are swapped between the target entry in history_panel and the target entry in terminal_panel. The global evidence-code token multiset is therefore identical across structural-location twins.
intervention_lock.framing_intervention: A record-like versus state-like frame_note changes only interpretive framing; data keys, target identity, evidence codes, rules, interventions, and structural-location manipulation remain otherwise matched.
intervention_lock.R: Rename the target identity globally and consistently across both panels and rules.
intervention_lock.T: Reverse target position within the matched trace sequence in both panels; the same T operation is applied regardless of which panel carries the decisive evidence code.
intervention_lock.semantic_valid: The single decisive evidence code licenses intervention u1 with predicted_direction=different.
intervention_lock.semantic_null: The single decisive evidence code says the target is challenge-invariant and licenses abstention/NONE.

endpoints.primary: beta-mixture stopping-time operator effect with width 0.50, identical construction to P60
endpoints.behavioral: fixed-horizon joint-error operator effect over valid/null semantic twins

factorial_test.assignment_space: Within each of the three skins, independently permute the four observed factorial-cell task effects over the four framing×location labels; 24^3 = 13,824 assignments per operator and endpoint.
factorial_test.location_statistic: mean(terminal_embedded - history_externalized), averaging framing and skin
factorial_test.framing_statistic: mean(state_frame - record_frame), averaging structural location and skin
factorial_test.primary_family: R and T structural-location tests; Holm FWER 0.05
factorial_test.framing_rival_family: R and T framing tests; Holm FWER 0.05
factorial_test.interaction_rival_family: R and T frame×structure interaction tests; Holm FWER 0.05

transport_gates.task_sign_reversal: For each primary operator, framing level, and skin, history-externalized and terminal-embedded task-level operator effects must be nonzero and have opposite signs.
transport_gates.block_sign_reversal: The same opposite-sign requirement must hold separately in A and B draw blocks for every matched framing×skin pair.
transport_gates.orientation_transport: For each operator, the history→terminal sign orientation must be identical across all six framing×skin matched pairs; orientation is not chosen in advance, only cross-pair consistency is required.
transport_gates.behavioral_concordance: The fixed-horizon endpoint must independently satisfy its structural-location Holm family and the same task/block/orientation gates for the strongest branch.

technical_gate.rule: Any provider/schema failure closes P63 as TECHNICAL_HOLD. No failed-cell replay occurs inside P63; any bounded recovery requires a new P-number.

claim_ceiling: Even the strongest P63 branch identifies a black-box causal effect of evidence location under the tested matched synthetic archive grammar and hosted model/provider contract. It does not establish a neural mechanism or a universal representation law.
